company.name: PerShop
company.shortDescription: PerShop is a personalized shopping site that only recommends you items from your favorite brands, in your size, in your price range.
company.description: PerShop Shopping online can be frustrating because you’re either hopping between individual brands without comparative pricing, seeing too many irrelevant products on aggregators, or can’t checkout on social apps. PerShop is a personalized shopping site that only recommends you items from your favorite brands, in your size, in your price range. Eventually it plans to sell personalized, targeted e-commerce ads. PerShop gets smarter as people use it to buy or just for entertainment.
